Q1.evaluated_as: phase_results.json prediction_inputs.Q1.screen_dF_exit_below_0 <= 9, over report.marginal_value_table.rows with source == "screen" (18 rows; dF_exit = F_exit(x) - F_exit(x0), x0 = this phase's x0 exit run, report.marginal_value_table.x0). A row without a numeric dF_exit (uncertified / harness_error) is not counted as dF_exit < 0; the number of such rows = prediction_inputs.Q1.screen_rows - prediction_inputs.Q1.screen_certified, reported beside
Q1.statement: at most 9 of the 18 screen plans have dF_exit < 0 against 1× x0

Q2.evaluated_as: phase_results.json prediction_inputs.Q2: harness_error_summaries == 0 (every summary the phase read, cache included) and local_solve_failures_total == 0 (sum of evaluation_record.local_solve_failures over every evaluation the phase launched)
Q2.statement: 0 harness_error and 0 local-solve failures over the phase

Q4.evaluated_as: the author's loop ends with exit 0 (phase_results.json report.termination.reason == "phase_complete") and phase_results.json hours.cumulative_h <= 60 (prediction_inputs.Q4)
Q4.statement: the search terminates (exit 0) inside the 60 h ceiling

Q5.evaluated_as: phase_results.json prediction_inputs.Q5.peak_child_rss_gib = max over every evaluation the phase launched of evaluation_record.peak_rss.child_python_process_ru_maxrss / 2^30 <= 3.29

band_measure_information_only.rule: v1 measure: certified rows with |F_exit(x) - F_exit(x0)| <= e_EV over every row; recorded beside the deciding measure, read by no decision (Planner decision P1)

efficiency.rule: fraction of the screen and ladder rows whose class against x0 at exit is NOT worse (confirm_candidate + unresolved; Planner decision P1) (denominator: every screen and ladder row, uncertified ones included); > 1/2 -> every later poll evaluation runs directly to K_EV (settled_direct), else exit_then_confirm

Q6.evaluated_as: phase_results.json report.efficiency holds n_not_worse, n_rows, class_counts (per exit class), the exact fraction, the branch taken, the rule, and band_measure_information_only (the v1 band fraction and the branch it would have given) (prediction_inputs.Q6)
Q6.statement: the efficiency fraction is recorded (no direction predicted)

Q7.evaluated_as: AUTOMATIC: P.exit_view_check in phase_step at candidate_confirmation (fields read_cycle, F, bar; float.hex identity). phase_results.json report.candidates[i].exit_view_check (equal, differing, exit_run, exit_view, mode) and prediction_inputs.Q7 (n_checked, n_equal, termination_reason)
Q7.statement: as at 2×: for each candidate, the exit run's (read_cycle, F, bar) equals bitwise the exit_view of the candidate's settled summary

Q8.evaluated_as: after the phase, at zero solves: for each of the 18 screen labels, d = dF_exit(1x) - dF_exit(2x), dF_exit(1x) from this phase's phase_results.json report.marginal_value_table.rows (source == "screen"; also prediction_inputs.Q8.screen_dF_exit), dF_exit(2x) from reference_2x.screen_dF_exit_2x (= phase2x_ev_v3/phase_results.json, sha256 cited); mean(d) > 0 over the labels with a numeric dF_exit at both levels; n of such labels reported (the statement's 18 holds iff n = 18; all 18 are certified at 2x)
Q8.statement: price monotonicity — the mean over the 18 screen plans of [dF_exit(1×) − dF_exit(2×)], each against its own price level's x0, is > 0

Q9.evaluated_as: phase_results.json prediction_inputs.Q9: over every settled summary the phase read, leak.priced_loss_eur (the cost breakdown's leak_detector.priced_loss_eur, mapping v2) <= 25 (mapping leak_ceiling_eur): n_above_ceiling == 0 and without_leak_z empty (a settled summary without a numeric leak is listed, not counted as holding)
Q9.statement: the within-cohort leak, loss-priced, is ≤ 25 € on every settled evaluation
